title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
**Job Description**
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.
  
  
This role is suited for a strong hands-on software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing modern applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments.
  
  
You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features and services from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, integration, troubleshooting, and production readiness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Full-Stack & Platform Engineering
  
  

* Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components.
* Implement well-defined service interfaces, APIs, contracts, and reusable abstractions.
* Develop event-driven services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Build services interacting with relational databases, time-series data stores, caching technologies, and file/object storage.
* Implement reliable service-to-service communication, error handling, retry, and integration patterns.
* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services and their dependencies.
* Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments.
* Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations.
* Apply abstraction and adapter patterns where needed to minimize unnecessary cloud-provider dependencies.
* Develop software capable of operating in Cognition edge/appliance environments, including deployments with limited or restricted connectivity.
* Build platform components with appropriate consideration for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization.
* Develop and support services deployed in Kubernetes-based environments.
* Contribute to installation, configuration, upgrade, and lifecycle-management capabilities for platform services.
* Follow engineering and security requirements associated with regulated, restricted-connectivity, or air-gapped deployments.

Engineering & Collaboration Expectations
  
  

* Take ownership of assigned features, services, and technical problems with limited supervision.
* Translate technical designs and requirements into high-quality working software.
* Participate constructively in architecture and design discussions.
* Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain engineering standards.
* Collaborate effectively with technical leads, architects, Product Owners, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, and application teams.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early.
* Diagnose technical issues spanning applications, services, messaging, databases, Kubernetes, and infrastructure.
* Contribute to technical investigations and proof-of-concepts for new technologies or platform capabilities.

**Qualifications**
Core Technical Qualifications
  
  
The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience with most of the following:
  
  

* Modern full-stack application development
* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering
* RESTful APIs and backend service development
* .NET and C# development
* Microservices and distributed-system concepts
* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
* RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology
* SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms
* Caching technologies such as Redis
* Data-processing and persistence concepts
* Authentication, authorization, and secure API design
* Automated unit, API, component, and integration testing
* Observability, structured logging, and production troubleshooting
* Git-based development, branching, pull-request, and release workflows

Strong hands-on experience with .NET/C# is particularly relevant to the existing platform-services landscape.
  
  
Experience Profile
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software-development experience, with substantial hands-on development responsibility.
* Strong experience building production-quality backend, full-stack, or platform software.
* Experience developing services using microservice, API-driven, and distributed-system architectures.
* Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features.
* Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments.

**Preferred / Differentiating Experience**
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:
  
  

* Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms
* Edge computing or appliance-based software
* Hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud platforms
* Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments
* Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems
* Kubernetes-based edge deployments
* Time-series databases
* Device and gateway management

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless architectures, API development, data pipelines, Graph APIs, and graph database capabilities on AWS is essential.

**What you’ll do:**

* Work within a cross-functional POD to deliver AWS services that support customer-facing experiences across Agilent.com, AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, eCommerce, content discovery, and the connected digital ecosystem.
* Design, build, and support serverless AWS ETL services that extract, transform, enrich, normalize, and deliver product, content, search, and customer experience data to downstream platforms.

* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations.

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a
**hands-on AI/ML Engineer**
to join our
**Information Systems (IS)**
.

**specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**
. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.
  
  
If you have experience with
**Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**
, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!
  
  
**Work model:**
Hybrid
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from SAP and Salesforce to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from Snowflake and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, cost monitoring, root-cause analysis, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**
**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical Skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake AI/ML tools (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating SAP and Salesforce data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
* Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team at one.com India is the core technical force within the Monitoring and 3rd Level department. We are expanding our department with a Site Reliability Engineer who specializes in deep infrastructure diagnostics and system-level troubleshooting. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the uptime of our massive footprint of Shared, Dedicated, and OpenStack-based VPS environments, alongside modern containerized applications. A core focus of this position is utilizing our unified, in-house monitoring application (powered by a Prometheus backend) to proactively track infrastructure health, interpret complex system metrics, and rapidly isolate the root cause of service degradations.
  
  
As an SRE III, you will own critical incidents, mentor junior SREs (SRE I/II) within the department, and ensure seamless monitoring visibility across legacy systems, Plesk setups, and Kubernetes clusters.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Proactive Infrastructure Monitoring: Utilize our in-house monitoring application to maintain constant visibility over our environments. Analyze metric trends and implement robust, symptom-based alerting thresholds across Shared, Dedicated, VPS, and Kubernetes environments to catch issues before they impact products.
* 3rd Level Customer issues and Infrastructure Outage Resolution: Act as the primary technical responder and diagnostic expert during critical service or product outages, performing deep-system troubleshooting under pressure.
* Diverse Platform Support: Diagnose and maintain maximum uptime and performance for traditional webhosting tech stacks, Plesk control panels, and multi-tenant OpenStack VPS environments.
* Proactive Problem Management: Analyze long-term metric trends using advanced PromQL to identify systemic performance bottlenecks, hardware degradations, or configuration drift, driving deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Internal Department Mentorship: Coach and guide SRE I and SRE II engineers within the department to elevate the team's collective diagnostic capabilities and troubleshooting workflows using our in-house monitoring application.

Core Technical Experience
  
  

* Advanced Linux Internals: Deep, low-level understanding of Linux operating systems (CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O bottlenecks, kernel logs, file systems, and network stack troubleshooting).
* Applied Prometheus & PromQL Expertise: Strong proficiency as a power user of Prometheus-backed monitoring tools. Expert-level ability to write highly optimized PromQL queries for complex alerting, dashboarding, and live incident troubleshooting.
* Multi-Tenant Hosting Ecosystems: Extensive hands-on experience diagnosing failures in both traditional Shared/Dedicated Linux hosting architectures and modern Plesk control panel environments.
* OpenStack & Virtualization Monitoring: Practical experience monitoring and troubleshooting Virtual Private Servers (VPS) and hypervisor behavior within an OpenStack cloud environment.
* Kubernetes Workload Monitoring: Proven track record of tracking the health of containerized applications, utilizing tools like Prometheus Operator or Kube-State-Metrics to isolate pod, node, or cluster-level issues.

* Advanced Linux Systems Engineering & OS Internals (Kernel, I/O, Networking)
* Applied Prometheus monitoring (Advanced PromQL, Metric Analysis)
* OpenStack VPS infrastructure diagnostics and health management
* Kubernetes workload and container-level monitoring
* Webhosting services stack (Plesk, Nginx, Apache, Postfix, DNS)

Mandatory Behavioral & Leadership Skills
  
  

* Advanced Systemic Debugging: Exceptional ability to isolate and trace complex bugs across disparate legacy and cloud systems under pressure.
* Analytical Thinking: Relies heavily on deterministic data and metrics to solve architectural and server-level problems.
* Team Mentorship: Strong collaborative mindset with a willingness to mentor SRE I/II peers within the department.
* Clear Synthesis: Translates complex incident realities into structured technical documentation and clear, actionable feedback for platform/development teams.

Desirable / Optional Skills
  
  

* Automation & Scripting: Ability to write or modify scripts (Python, GoLang, or advanced Bash/Shell) to assist in data gathering or routine tasks is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Experience with configuration management tools (such as Chef or Ansible).

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, ECE, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience: 4–8 years of experience in IT operations, with a strong focus on high-scale Webhosting, Managed Service Providers (MSP), or infrastructure administration.
* Direct SRE/3rd-Level Experience: Minimum of 2 years strictly in an SRE or 3rd-level infrastructure engineering role dealing with large-scale distributed systems and deep diagnostics.

Linux Systems Engineering, OS Internals, 3rd Level Incident Management, Outage Resolution, Prometheus Power User, PromQL, OpenStack Monitoring, Kubernetes Monitoring, Plesk Administration, Shared Hosting, Dedicated Servers, VPS Monitoring, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Nginx, Varnis

Skyhigh Security is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. You will take proactive, senior-level responsibility for the day-to-day security architecture and automation of our non-production environments. Your impact will be measured by your ability to keep our complex developer labs running smoothly, collaborate effectively with local team security champions, and build the automated auditing systems that ensure long-term compliance with our security policies.
  
  
You must have solid, hands-on technical expertise in on-premises virtualization, configuration automation, and systems-level security to work effectively within the Engineering Excellence team. You’ll build strong collaborative relationships with distributed Engineering teams, Security Champions, and Operations to ensure our non-production environments remain robust and secure without slowing down developer velocity.
  
  
****Senior Platform Security Engineer – Engineering Excellence****
Skyhigh Security is hiring a Senior Platform Security Engineer to join our Engineering Excellence organization, reporting to the Senior Manager of Engineering Environments and Core Tooling. In this high-impact, technical role, you will be a vital player in maintaining, automating, and securing our developer labs and test environments, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and highly secure.
  
  
You will take proactive, senior-level responsibility for the day-to-day security architecture and automation of our non-production environments. * Build Shared Security Capabilities: Design and deploy robust security capabilities specifically for shared resources, including common labs and shared environments.
* Maintain Platform Security Standards: Keep environment security policies up to date, ensuring they reflect current engineering standards and evolving security landscapes.
* Operational Security Alignment: Ensure that shared environment configurations, access controls, and network boundaries are continuously aligned with corporate security guidelines.

****Requirements****

* 5 to 8 years of relevant industry experience.
* Environment & Lab Administration: Extensive, hands-on experience maintaining complex test environments, developer labs, staging infrastructures, or container registries in a modern software engineering organization.
* Systems Security Mindset: A strong understanding of core security principles (e.g, Identity & Access Management, network segmentation, least privilege) applied to on-premises systems and networks.
* Automated Auditing & Drift Detection: Ability to design systems that systematically track, document, and validate security compliance across multiple teams.
* Collaborative Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work constructively with distributed teams and security champions, acting as a helpful partner rather than a rigid blocker.
* Adaptability & Drive: Demonstrated ability to manage varied technical challenges—from complex network troubleshooting to security enforcement—with a self-motivated drive for results.

****Tooling Requirements****
****Deep Core Expertise****

* Software Supply Chain Security: Experience leveraging Artifactory to govern open-source dependencies, and Black Duck to enforce vulnerability checking.

****Broad / Functional Competency****

* AWS Cloud Fundamentals: Basic understanding of AWS structures, including AWS security groups, IAM access keys, and public cloud VPC boundaries.
* Container Orchestration: General familiarity deploying workloads to cloud-based Kubernetes platforms (utilizing Helm charts or basic ArgoCD continuous delivery configurations).
* Security & Compliance Tools: Familiarity with vulnerability scanners (e.g., Trivy, Snyk) or basic configuration auditing tools.

If you’re excited to safeguard modern cloud engineering environments and support developer labs at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

****Job Summary****
Provides solutions for IT and business management on applying technology to business opportunities, planning and implementation of cross-functional applications. Architects and delivers AI-enabled enterprise solutions across the PSLD supply chain landscape, sitting at the intersection of applied Artificial Intelligence and deep supply chain domain expertise. Defines which AI ecosystem Caterpillar adopts for a given business problem and translates complex supply chain processes into scalable, compliant, measurable digital capability.
  
  
This is a hands-on architecture role with enterprise influence: evaluates and benchmarks competing AI platforms, establishes reference architectures, architecture standards and governance guardrails, and embeds agentic and generative AI patterns into the way Caterpillar plans, sources, distributes and services parts worldwide — while sustaining continuity of the existing .NET, React, SAP-integrated, Mainframe application estate.
  
  
****What You Will Do:****

* Provide consulting services to internal business groups on process improvement projects designed to improve their business results.
* Analyze, define and document client's requirements, and revise existing systems logic challenges, as necessary.
* Monitor client experiences and feedback on the use of business applications; enhance system productivity, as needed.
* Participate in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems that are cost effective and meet business requirements.
* Ecosystem selection: Independently evaluate, benchmark and recommend the optimal AI ecosystem — Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot / Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini and comparable frontier models — against cost, accuracy, latency, context window, tool-calling maturity, data residency and enterprise security criteria.
* Copilot & Agentic AI adoption: Lead the PSLD adoption roadmap for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and agentic AI — identifying high-value use cases, running pilots, measuring adoption and productivity impact, and scaling proven agents into production.
* Architecture standards: Establish, publish and govern architecture standards, design patterns and technology guardrails for AI and application development across PSLD.
* Reference architecture: Define and own reference architectures for RAG, multi-agent orchestration, MCP-based tool integration, fine-tuning vs. prompt-engineering trade-offs, and model routing / fallback strategies.
* Build vs. buy: Produce objective decision frameworks and proof-of-concepts that guide leadership investment decisions across competing AI platforms and licensing models.
* Responsible AI: Embed evaluation harnesses, hallucination controls, prompt-injection defences, into every deployed solution, aligned to Caterpillar enterprise AI governance

Automation strategy: Own the PSLD automation portfolio — assess processes for RPA, Power Platform, workflow or agentic automation; prioritise by feasibility, complexity and ROI; and retire or rationalise legacy automations.
  
  

* Platform modernization: Drive modernization across applications, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, RPA,. NET, Mainframe, SAP integrations and data platforms — moving from bespoke point solutions toward reusable, governed enterprise capability.
* Technical debt reduction: Assess the existing application estate, define a modernization roadmap, and sequence remediation against business risk and value. Set engineering standards, conduct design and code reviews, and mentor developers on AI-assisted SDLC practices using GitHub Copilot and agentic tooling.
* Act as the technical authority in leadership forums, presenting architecture options and trade-offs in clear, business-oriented terms.
* Drive reusability — build shared AI components, prompt libraries, connectors and accelerators consumable across PSLD and the wider enterprise.

**Degree Requirement**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent.
  
  

* Minimum 12 years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience delivering production AI / GenAI solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable experience delivering technology solutions for supply chain, manufacturing or logistics business functions.
* Proven record of architecture ownership on at least one large, multi-system, cross-functional programme.

****What You Have****
Technical Skills – Required
  
  

* AI Platforms & Models: Working depth across Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot / Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI and Google Gemini. Able to articulate comparative strengths, cost profiles and enterprise fit, and to justify platform selection with evidence.
* Copilot & Agentic AI: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, custom agents and connectors, agent governance, adoption measurement and change management.
* GenAI Engineering: Prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector search and embeddings, function/tool calling, MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, model evaluation and benchmarking, guardrails and observability.
* AI-Assisted SDLC: GitHub Copilot, spec-driven development, automated test generation (e.g. Playwright), AI-generated documentation and governance agents.
* Application Engineering: Microsoft .NET / C#, React, REST and event-driven APIs, microservices and secure integration patterns.
* Cloud & Data: Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, API Management, Azure AI Services, Key Vault); Snowflake or equivalent cloud data platform; SQL Server; data modelling for analytics and AI workloads.
* Automation & Low-Code: Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio) and RPA tooling such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere or Blue Prism.
* Security & Compliance: Secure-by-design application architecture, identity and access management, vulnerability remediation, and partnership with infrastructure and security teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with agentic architectures in a regulated or global-trade context.
* Exposure to heavy manufacturing, dealer networks or aftermarket parts distribution.
* Prior experience within Caterpillar PSLD or an equivalent parts and logistics organisation

Experience coordinating delivery across business, SAP, infrastructure and security teams in a global enterprise.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Expert:**

title: Technical Support Architect (AI)
description:
**Overview**
Serve as the AI Architect for the Support organization. Define the AI strategy, architecture, and governance that improve how Support resolves cases, communicates with clients, and shares knowledge. Design, build, integrate, and optimize AI-enabled solutions across ServiceNow, knowledge management, case triage, and incident response. As a secondary responsibility, provide help desk and after-hours technical support to clients, including call, ticket, email, and chat support, and coordinate timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
  
  
Primary Objective: Architect and deliver secure, reliable, and measurable AI solutions that improve Support efficiency, resolution quality, and client experience, while ensuring responsible use of AI and protection of client, patient, and company information. Secondary Objective: Provide responsive, professional help desk and after-hours support, maintain clear client communication, and work with internal teams to resolve critical and escalated issues with minimal business disruption.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities – AI Architecture**

* Define and maintain the AI architecture, roadmap, and standards for the Support organization, aligned with Support, Product, and Security priorities.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases across case intake, triage and routing, troubleshooting, case summarization, knowledge creation, client communication, quality audits, and major incident support.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions and workflows, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation, integrated with ServiceNow and other support tools.
* Architect and curate knowledge sources, including knowledge articles, SOPs, known-error records, and case history, so that AI outputs are accurate, current, and relevant.
* Establish AI governance, including approved tools and models, data-handling rules, PHI and client data protection, output validation, human review, and compliance with applicable policies and regulations.
* Partner with Information Security, IT, Product Development, and Support leadership to assess risk, select platforms, and implement secure integrations.
* Define success metrics and report on AI adoption, accuracy, time savings, SLA and response-time improvements, and client satisfaction. Continuously test, tune, and improve solutions.
* Use AI and data analysis to identify recurring issues, trends, and suspected defects, and share insights with Product Development to support product improvements.
* Train, coach, and enable Support staff and managers on approved AI tools, effective prompting, output verification, and responsible use. Create guides, SOPs, and best practices.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, healthcare IT trends, and supported Altera products, and recommend improvements to the Support AI strategy.

**Secondary Responsibilities – Help Desk & After-Hours Support**

* Provide help desk and after-hours support by answering inbound calls and responding to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.
* Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.
* Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces. Investigate issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs.
* Identify root causes where possible, implement approved fixes or workarounds, validate service restoration, and update tickets with complete resolution details.
* Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.
* Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls, follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures, and support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, and documenting incident timelines.
* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.
* Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information.
* Participate in scheduled evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of the 24/7 support schedule.

**Qualifications**
**Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support, healthcare IT, or a related technical field.
* Experience with generative AI tools and solutions, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms, including prompt engineering and workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices and data privacy, including protection of PHI and other sensitive information.
* Ability to define use cases and success metrics and to communicate results to technical and executive audiences.
* Strong written, verbal, and telephone communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Ability to troubleshoot software issues, prioritize multiple cases, and recognize when escalation is needed.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and working both independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of SQL Server and Windows Server (including IIS) is preferred.
* Familiarity with the U.S. healthcare industry, HL7 interfaces, and enterprise healthcare software is preferred.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**

* Some travel may be required for client engagement, collaboration, or onsite support activities.
* Primary work is performed during standard business hours. Availability for assigned evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations is required to support the secondary help desk and after-hours responsibilities.

title: Engineering Manager, Core Infrastructure
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
Stripe Infrastructure is responsible for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of Stripe’s systems and the productivity and sentiment of Stripe’s people. You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas within Core Infrastructure. We’re the home for Stripe's critical tier0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency and scalability of these systems.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
As an Engineering Manager in Core Infrastructure at Stripe, you will lead a team solving challenging distributed systems problems and drive critical improvements in our foundational platform.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborating with senior leadership to define and execute strategic initiatives for Stripe's core infrastructure.
* Leading and mentoring a team of experienced engineers, fostering their growth and career development.
* Driving technical decisions and architectural improvements for large-scale, distributed systems.
* Partnering with product and engineering teams across Stripe to identify and implement infrastructure solutions that enhance scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
* Cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Supporting the engineering team in achieving a high level of technical quality, reliability, and ease-of-use.
* Recruiting great engineers, in collaboration with Stripe's recruiting team

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of industry experience in software engineering, with at least 3-4 years in engineering management roles.
* Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and infrastructure.
* Extensive experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS.
* Strong background in multiple areas of infrastructure, such as compute, networking, databases, caching systems, or storage.
* Proven track record of leading and growing high-performing engineering teams.
* Experience in managing geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to drive technical strategy and roadmap planning for complex infrastructure systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with globally distributed systems and multi-region architectures.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of performance optimization and capacity planning for large-scale systems.
* Experience in scaling infrastructure platforms to handle millions of requests per second (RPS).
* Track record of successful cross-functional project leadership.
* Familiarity with programming languages commonly used in infrastructure, such as Go, Ruby, or Java.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

Whether you join our Statistics, Optimization or Machine Learning teams, you’ll be challenged to harness Target’s impressive data breadth to build the algorithms that power solutions our partners in Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Network Security and Personalization rely on.
  
  
****Team Overview****
Target’s Advanced AI team builds end-to-end AI/ML systems that create meaningful business value across the enterprise. These systems may be powered by LLMs, classical machine learning, or deep learning models, and are designed as scalable, reliable, production-grade applications, including agentic architectures where they add clear value.
  
  
****Role Overview****
As a
**Lead AI Engineer**
for
**Advanced AI,**
you will help design, build, deploy, and maintain AI/ML applications that support automation, insight, and action across core business workflows. You will work closely with Data Scientists, engineers, product partners, platform teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for AI engineering initiatives. You will contribute to architecture and design decisions, evaluate appropriate models, frameworks, and tools, write maintainable production-quality code, and help establish strong engineering practices across development, testing, deployment, observability, documentation, and ongoing support. You will also partner with senior engineers and engineering leaders to shape technical approaches, identify implementation risks, resolve roadblocks, and support the evolution of reusable AI engineering patterns. This role requires curiosity and continuous learning, including staying current with developments in AI, machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, and modern software engineering practices. A successful Lead AI Engineer will help deliver production-grade AI applications that create measurable business value while raising the technical quality and capability of the broader team.

****About You****

title: Data Engineer
description:
"Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Databricks Data Engineer to design and enhance enterprise document-processing and data-extraction solutions. The role will focus on ingesting structured and unstructured content, extracting business and policy information using LLM-based approaches, improving extraction accuracy, and making validated information available to downstream applications through an ontology-driven data layer.
  
  
The engineer will join a small, hands-on team working on document intelligence solutions supporting brokerage and underwriting workflows. A major focus will be redesigning existing pipelines to improve accuracy, performance, scalability, and maintainability while supporting a broader migration from Microsoft Fabric to Databricks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and optimize Databricks data pipelines for document ingestion, classification, extraction, validation, and downstream consumption.
* Process information from multiple document and communication formats, including:
* PDF documents
* Emails and attachments
* Excel/XLSX files
* Insurance applications
* Statements of Values (SOVs)
* Other structured and unstructured documents
* Improve existing extraction pipelines where LLMs produce false positives, incorrect metadata, or inaccurate field values.
* Develop validation and quality-control approaches that improve the reliability of extracted information.
* Implement document classification and content-aware extraction strategies.
* Handle source-specific extraction rules, such as extracting particular attributes from an email rather than from attached documents.
* Design pipelines that transform extracted information into consistent, structured JSON outputs for downstream applications.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of a custom ontology layer that represents key insurance business entities and relationships.
* Map extracted information into the ontology so applications can consume standardized business concepts rather than raw document fields.
* Address performance challenges associated with processing large or complex Excel/XLSX and SOV files.
* Optimize pipeline scalability and concurrency for production workloads.
* Work with PostgreSQL/Lakebase-based persistence for final structured outputs.
* Collaborate closely with brokerage, underwriting, AI, and data engineering teams to connect extracted application data with downstream underwriting processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and production data engineering.
* Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL.
* Experience building scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines on the Databricks platform.
* Experience processing unstructured and semi-structured data, particularly PDFs, emails, Excel files, JSON, and business documents.
* Experience integrating LLMs or AI models into data-processing pipelines.
* Understanding of prompt-based and structured data extraction from documents.
* Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, or quality controls for AI-generated outputs.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, schemas, entity relationships, and semantic/ontology concepts.
* Experience designing APIs, JSON structures, or data products for downstream application consumption.
* Experience troubleshooting performance, scalability, and concurrency issues in production data pipelines.
* Experience working with cloud-based data architectures.

Minimum 7+ years of experience in data engineering, software development, or production data pipeline development.
  
  
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks and scalable data-processing pipelines."

**Senior Manager – Integrated System Lead**
**What you will do:**
In this role as an individual contributor, you will coordinate integrated clinical system delivery across a defined group of platforms and study processes. You will maintain visibility of end-to-end dependencies across Clinical systems and enterprise data platforms, surface data and interface risks early, and help teams deliver reliable, traceable information flow measured by on-time delivery, interface quality, and data integrity.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership**

* Maintain an integrated view of upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, data consumers, and delivery milestones for assigned systems or initiatives, so that the impact of a change in one system is understood across the clinical ecosystem.
* Contribute to integration and data flow standards, requirements, design decisions, and roadmap planning, ensuring cross-system sequencing and dependencies are reflected in release plans.
* Identify gaps in ownership, data quality, traceability, and operational readiness across system handoffs, and recommend practical actions with clear owners and success measures.

**Execution and Delivery Leadership**

* Coordinate system owners and delivery teams through requirements, interface design, end-to-end integration testing, release, and operational handoff, aligning release timing across dependent systems.
* Track interface and data issues, cross-system dependencies, decisions, and remediation actions through resolution, with clear visibility of aging, impact, and time to resolve.
* Support clear documentation of system context, data flows, controls, and support ownership.
* Define and report measurable integration outcomes, such as on-time milestone delivery, interface defect and failure rates, data reconciliation timeliness, and post-release incident trends.
* Review delivery outcomes and recurring issues to identify improvements to reliability and usability and demonstrate measurable progress over time.

**Individual Contribution**

* Work as an individual contributor, independently managing assigned integration work and coordinating across capability teams.
* Share system and data flow knowledge to support consistent decisions and effective handoffs.

**External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships**

* Partner with clinical system owners, Data Management, Clinical Operations, AI&D, DTI, architecture, security, privacy, and vendors.
* Facilitate working sessions to resolve cross-system requirements, dependencies, and conflicting priorities between platform teams.
* Provide concise, metrics-based status and risk updates to capability leadership and program teams.

**What we expect of you:**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree and 8+ years of experience in clinical systems, system integration, data management, or technology delivery in a regulated environment OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 11+ years of experience in clinical systems, system integration, data management, or technology delivery in a regulated environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience coordinating integrations, system delivery, data flow, or cross-platform implementations with multiple interdependent systems and vendors.
* Understanding of clinical development processes and common clinical system data exchanges.
* Knowledge of requirements, testing, release, and change management practices.
* Strong facilitation, documentation, and issue-tracking skills.

**Core Competencies:**

* Ability to understand end-to-end system interactions, cross-system dependencies, and data lineage.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional technical work and vendors.
* Data quality and compliance awareness.
* Clear communication and disciplined follow-through.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:
  
  

* Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
* Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
* Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
* Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

* Ensure solutions account for Caterpillar's diverse equipment population, embedded controllers, communication technologies, machine architectures, and legacy products.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Partner with product groups, embedded controls teams, connectivity teams, enterprise software teams, cybersecurity, digital product organizations, dealers, and external engineering partners.
* Translate product and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities.
* Lead technical trade-off and prioritization discussions involving architecture, cost, schedule, risk, and long-term maintainability.
* Communicate technical strategy, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to engineering and business leadership.

What You Have
  
  
**Required**

* Experience delivering complex distributed, embedded, connected-product, or cloud-integrated systems.

Software is becoming an increasingly important part of Caterpillar products. The ability to safely update software remotely at scale reduces equipment downtime and support cost while allowing Caterpillar to deliver improvements more rapidly.
  
  
This manager will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for making remote software updates a reliable, scalable capability across current and future Caterpillar products.

description:

R&D Team Lead
  
  
  
  
  
**Your role and responsibilities :**
We are seeking a skilled Senior Cybersecurity Specialist with deep knowledge of product security, secure software development, and cybersecurity engineering to join our team. You will manage the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls for digital products and solutions, ensuring they are secure, resilient, and compliant with applicable cybersecurity standards and regulations. This role requires a unique combination of security engineering knowledge, risk management, threat modeling, and software development lifecycle security to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable products in production environments.
  
  
The work model for the role is:
  
  
This role is contributing to the Motion Business Service Division in Bangalore India.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Own the secure software development lifecycle and guide the product team to implement the security practices at different stages of the software development process.
* Own software supply chain security, including defenses against risks from open-source packages, third-party binaries, container base images, build tools, and other software dependencies.
* Own first-party software security, including code and container scanning, automated security testing in CI, external penetration tests, and the integrity and provenance of software we build and publish.
* Own and run the responsible vulnerability disclosure program, including triaging external reports, maintaining submission quality standards, and scaling the review process.
* Partner with engineering teams from concept through implementation to conduct security design reviews, define secure architectures, and ensure security best practices are followed.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Product Security & Secure SDLC: 10+ years of experience across software engineering, application security, security engineering, or product security, with deep knowledge of Secure SDLC, Secure by Design, Secure by Default, OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-53, and IEC 62443-4-2 standards.
* Security Architecture & Risk Assessment: Experience in conducting secure design and architecture reviews, developing reusable security reference architectures and security blueprints aligned with Microsoft Security Baselines and Bow-Tie models, and performing product security risk assessments.
* Threat Modeling & Security Analysis: Proficiency in STRIDE, DREAD, PASTA, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks, with experience using tools such as IriusRisk and Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool to identify threats, assess risks, and define mitigations.
* DevSecOps & Application Security: Practical experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST (SonarQube, WizCode), SCA (Black Duck Hub), DAST and vulnerability scanning (Nmap, Nessus, Qualys, Burp Suite), and SBOM generation and management using OWASP Dependency-Track.

* Experience with Digital Transformation or Product Modernization initiatives.
* Knowledge of APIs, system integrations, and enterprise application landscapes.
* Exposure to Data Analytics, AI/GenAI, Cloud, or Digital platforms.
* Experience working in SAFe Agile environments.
* Relevant certifications such as:

+ Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
+ Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO)
+ SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM)

* Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.
* Proven ability to prioritize competing requirements and deliver business value.
* Experience leading backlog management and product planning activities.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks and product lifecycle management.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Senior Manager – RBQM Platforms and Technologies**
**What you will do:**
In this role as an individual contributor, you will provide hands-on functional and delivery support for RBQM platforms and related technology. You will coordinate platform work and study enablement, help maintain compliant and reliable capabilities, and support the practical use of risk-based quality management across the portfolio.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership**

* Contribute to RBQM platform backlog and roadmap planning using study needs, user feedback, and operational metrics.
* Own defined platform workstreams, requirements, or product areas and maintain clear records of decisions and dependencies.
* Apply RBQM and system governance standards to platform changes and study use.

**Execution and Delivery Leadership**

* Coordinate configuration, integration, testing, release, and adoption activities with RBQM and technology stakeholders.
* Prepare requirements, test evidence, user guidance, and operational documentation.
* Track platform and data issues, resolve routine items, and escalate risks with clear impacts and recommended actions.
* Support study teams in using platform workflows and interpreting system outputs within established processes.

**Individual Contribution**

* Work as an individual contributor, independently managing assigned work and collaborating across RBQM, clinical operations, and technology teams.
* Share platform knowledge and support consistent practices across the capability.

**External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships**

* Partner with RBQM, Clinical Operations, Data Management, DTI, quality, and platform vendors.
* Coordinate vendor follow-up on defects, releases, and support requests.
* Provide clear status, issue, and risk updates to capability leadership.

**What we expect of you:**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree and 8+ years of experience in clinical systems, RBQM, clinical operations technology, or analytics in a regulated environment OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 11+ years of experience in clinical systems, RBQM, clinical operations technology, or analytics in a regulated environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting RBQM platforms, clinical systems, analytics, or study delivery.
* Understanding of clinical research processes and quality or risk-based monitoring concepts.
* Experience coordinating requirements, testing, releases, or vendor activities.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

**Core Competencies:**

* Knowledge of central monitoring, risk indicators, or quality oversight processes.
* Experience with platform configuration, data flows, or operational support.
* Quality-minded change management and documentation.
* Structured problem solving and dependable delivery.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:
  
  

* Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
* Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
* Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
* Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Revenue Experiences Engineering team is part of the Commerce Systems organization at Stripe. We focus on ensuring that our users, both internal and external, have a best-in-class experience with billing at Stripe. This includes working on the systems and processes needed to bill our largest and most complex customers, as well as designing and delivering experiences to help guide users through their billing, from fee explainability to deep diving on product usage optimization. We are a cross-functional technical team that seeks to bring clarity to a complex space. The team is at the crux of all Stripe products and builds user-facing as well as internal infrastructure.
  
  
We build platforms and services to define and manage pricing, calculate and collect Stripe's revenue, and empower Stripe and our users to understand and manage revenue and costs. We work on customer-facing experiences, internal platforms, and data pipelines to empower Accounting, Finance, Strategy, Sales, and Stripe's Products to drive business value across the entire user and product lifecycle.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join our India-based team and drive the technical roadmap for Revenue Experiences Engineering, collaborating deeply with partner teams across Commerce Systems in the US, EMEA, and India. In this role, you will work closely with engineering managers, senior engineers, and cross-functional partners to help design architecture, ensure technical excellence, and break down complex problems to make them more tractable with engineering teams. You will be involved in the building of the technical bench, mentoring and growing the next senior engineers within the broader organisation.
  
  
You will work cross-functionally to align on the business challenges in delivering excellent billing and accounting experiences to our users. Often this will include influencing across organizations and grounding your arguments in solid data and a technical roadmap. As such, you will have excellent technical leadership and communication skills.
  
  
You will also be hands-on in building key systems, while mentoring and leading other engineers. Join us in driving change in an area with tremendous opportunity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage the technical leadership, execution, and roadmap for Revenue Experiences Engineering.
* Work cross-functionally with business leaders across the company as well as partner engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering, product, and design leadership to define our product strategy and user experience.
* Ensure our platform solutions and user billing data are high quality, meet the needs of our internal users, and position us to meet Stripe's growth.
* Drive interoperability across platforms in User Billing and integrations across Stripe with product, accounting, sales, finance, and data science teams.
* Scrutinize billing interfaces and data models, elevating our focus on correctness and ease of use within User Billing.
* Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable the team to execute effectively.
* Foster a culture of learning and data-driven decision making on the team and to influence the broader organization.
* Mentor and support the growth of engineers at different levels in their careers.

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience building large-scale, distributed systems.
* Proven track record of building large-scale, complex distributed systems; identifying shortcomings and optimization opportunities; and making data-driven cost performance tradeoffs to influence design decisions.
* Experience building and operating infrastructure and tools that empower developers/product teams to deliver business value.
* Experience influencing company strategy at the intersection of business needs and technology (you measure your success in terms of business impact, not lines of code).
* Experience leading and creating strong technical teams that balance operational excellence, collaboration, and user needs.
* Strong collaboration skills to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Are effective in giving and receiving constructive feedback to/from peers and team members.
* Past experience mentoring and investing in the development of engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the financial technology space, particularly in payment processing, accounting, or financial reporting.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. * **Certifications:**

  Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.

Provide second- and third-level support for the Power BI service and Power BI Report Builder estate, covering operational, fleet, procurement, compliance, payroll and customer-facing reporting. Incident management and service restoration
  
  

* Own assigned ServiceNow incidents through resolution: refresh failures, gateway and credential failures, expired certificates, broken data sources and report errors.
* Distinguish user navigation issues from data and model defects, and publish shift-left knowledge articles for common issues such as filters, bookmarks and access so the Service Desk can resolve them.
* Trace data defects to source (data warehouse, ADF pipelines, SharePoint lists, other sources) and coordinate fixes with the owning engineer.

Monitoring and operational health
  
  

* Monitor scheduled refreshes, gateway health and capacity daily. Act on failures before business use.
* Maintain the gateway, credential and certificate expiry register, and renew before expiry.
* Make sure datasets, gateways and data sources are owned by service accounts, not named individuals.

Administration and service requests
  
  

* Administer workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, Premium/Fabric capacity settings, row-level security and sharing within delegated authority.
* Fulfil authorised report access requests, preferring AD/Entra group-based and self-service models with an audit trail.
* Support reports embedded in portals and intranet pages, including customer-facing reporting.

Change, release and enhancement
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy minor enhancements to reports, semantic models (DAX, Power Query) and paginated reports through change control.
* Support business-requested measures and visuals while keeping metric definitions agreed with business owners.
* Take delivered reporting from projects into BAU with documentation and ownership transfer.

Problem management and knowledge
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring refresh and data issues, and drive permanent fixes.
* Maintain the report catalogue (owner, source, refresh, RLS model), metric definitions, runbooks and knowledge articles. Keep PBIX and RDL source under version control.
* Participate in knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, demonstrate independent handling of common support scenarios, and transfer knowledge to new team members.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Use privileged and production access only through the approved access process (e.g. CyberArk), on a least-privilege basis and for authorised tasks.
* Never record passwords, tokens or other secrets in tickets, email or documents. Store and hand over credentials only through the approved vault.
* Handle customer, employee and payroll personal information in line with the Privacy Act and Cleanaway data classification, including compliant incident records and escalation of potential data breaches.
* Maintain segregation of duties: perform data corrections, approvals and production changes only with documented business or change approval, and keep an audit trail.
* Role boundaries

L2/L3 accountability
  
  

* Own Power BI incidents, refresh and gateway operations, workspace and security administration, and minor report and model enhancements.
* Retain ServiceNow ownership while upstream data engineers fix source issues.

Outside delegated authority
  
  

* Upstream data pipeline and data warehouse fixes, owned by the data warehouse and ADF/Databricks engineers.
* Business ownership of metric definitions, KPI targets and report audience decisions.
* Tenant-wide Power BI/Fabric governance and licensing decisions owned by the platform owner.
* Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Demonstrated enterprise production support and development experience with the Power BI service: datasets and semantic models, DAX, Power Query, on-premises data gateways, scheduled refresh and row-level security.
* Power BI Report Builder (paginated reports) and SQL skills against SQL Server and SSAS sources.
* Workspace, app and capacity administration and access management with Entra ID groups.
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request practice using ServiceNow or equivalent.
* Clear communication with business report owners and executives.

Desirable
  
  

* SSRS and SSAS (tabular) experience. Microsoft Fabric.
* Embedding Power BI in SharePoint or external portals. Power Platform awareness.
* Fleet, procurement or compliance reporting domain experience.
* PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Key relationships

**Business report owners (operations, fleet, procurement, finance, safety):**
Requirements, metric definitions, access approval and validation
  
  
**Data warehouse and ADF/Databricks engineers:**
Upstream data issues and model dependencies
  
  
**SharePoint & Power Platform engineers:**
Embedded reports and SharePoint list data sources
  
  
**Service Desk / L1:**
Intake, initial triage, shift-left knowledge articles and incident escalation
  
  
**Technical Platform Owner / Principal Analyst:**
Platform priorities, risks, technical governance and acceptance
  
  
**Change and release management:**
CAB approval, controlled releases and production validation
  
  
**Infrastructure, DBA and Cyber Security teams:**
Servers, databases, privileged access, certificates and security approvals
  
  

* Performance measures
* Incident response and resolution against agreed service levels and business-critical processing windows.
* Completion and effectiveness of proactive monitoring, exception detection and recovery.
* Service request timeliness and first-time-right fulfilment.
* Changes delivered successfully through change control, without unplanned outage or rollback.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through problem records, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Accuracy and currency of runbooks, knowledge articles, ServiceNow resolution notes and operational documentation.
